autoencoder.name: Autoencoder

language_model.name: Next token prediction
language_model.format: TXT with one sample per line

linear.label: Dense
linear.description: Learned transformation that combines all input features.
linear.usage: Use it as a hidden layer or output head after a vector/Flatten.

conv1d.label: Conv 1D
conv1d.description: Learns temporal filters over 1D signals or sequences.
conv1d.usage: Connect it to [B, F, T] or [B, T, F] tensors depending on layout.

conv2d.label: Conv 2D
conv2d.description: Learns spatial filters over images or feature maps.
conv2d.usage: Connect it to [B, C, H, W] tensors; control channels, kernel, stride and padding.

convtranspose2d.label: ConvTranspose 2D
convtranspose2d.description: Increases resolution through a learned transposed convolution.
convtranspose2d.usage: Used in decoders, usually before concatenating an equally-sized skip.

maxpool1d.label: MaxPool 1D
maxpool1d.description: Reduces temporal resolution keeping the maximum activation per window.
maxpool1d.usage: Place it between 1D convolutional blocks to compress the time axis.

avgpool1d.label: AvgPool 1D
avgpool1d.description: Reduces temporal resolution by averaging each window.

adaptiveavgpool1d.label: Global AvgPool 1D
adaptiveavgpool1d.description: Summarizes each feature to a fixed temporal size.
adaptiveavgpool1d.usage: Before Flatten/Dense it avoids depending on the exact sequence length.

maxpool2d.label: MaxPool 2D
maxpool2d.description: Reduces resolution keeping the maximum activation per window.
maxpool2d.usage: Place it between convolutional blocks to compress spatial information.

avgpool2d.label: AvgPool 2D
avgpool2d.description: Reduces resolution by averaging each window.
avgpool2d.usage: Smoother alternative to MaxPool when the mean response matters.

adaptiveavgpool2d.label: Global AvgPool
adaptiveavgpool2d.description: Summarizes each channel to a fixed output size.
adaptiveavgpool2d.usage: Before Flatten/Dense it avoids depending on the exact input resolution.

rnn.label: RNN
rnn.description: Classic recurrent cell with tanh activation.
rnn.usage: Receives [B, T, F] and connects to a head through a temporal selection.

gru.label: GRU
gru.description: Gated recurrent unit with fewer gates than LSTM.
gru.usage: Receives [B, T, F] and connects to a head through a temporal selection.

lstm.label: LSTM
lstm.description: Processes a sequence while keeping a temporal memory state.
lstm.usage: Receives [B, T, F] and usually connects to Last valid state.

temporal_select.label: Last valid state
temporal_select.description: Extracts the last usable state from the temporal axis.
temporal_select.usage: After an LSTM converts the sequence into a vector for a Dense head.

flatten.label: Flatten
flatten.description: Flattens non-batch dimensions into a single vector.
flatten.usage: Connects convolutional feature maps with Dense layers.

reshape.label: Reshape
reshape.description: Reorganizes the tensor without changing its element count.
reshape.usage: Use it when adapting a vector output to a horizon or specific shape.

permute.label: T,F → F,T
permute.usage: Use it to switch between time-first and feature-first layouts.

concat.label: Concatenate
concat.description: Concatenates several branches along the indicated axis.
concat.usage: Accepts several compatible inputs; typical skip union in U-Net.

add.label: Add
add.description: Element-wise sum of two or more branches of equal shape.
add.usage: Use for residual connections; all inputs must have the same shape.

resize2d.label: Resize 2D
resize2d.usage: Non-learnable upsampling for decoders; usually precedes a Conv 2D.

relu.label: ReLU
relu.description: Introduces non-linearity by letting positive values pass.
relu.usage: Usually placed after a Dense or Conv 2D layer.

leaky_relu.label: LeakyReLU
leaky_relu.description: ReLU variant that keeps a small slope for negatives.
leaky_relu.usage: Useful when you want to reduce dead neurons.

gelu.label: GELU
gelu.description: Smooth activation that weights values by their magnitude.
gelu.usage: Modern ReLU alternative common in recent networks.

silu.label: SiLU / Swish
silu.description: Smooth activation also known as Swish.
silu.usage: Good general option in dense or convolutional blocks.

sigmoid.label: Sigmoid
sigmoid.description: Maps each value to the 0–1 range.
sigmoid.usage: Only use it when the output contract or an intermediate block requires it.

tanh.label: Tanh
tanh.description: Maps each value to the −1…1 range.
tanh.usage: Useful in bounded states; avoid adding it unnecessarily at the output.

softmax.label: Softmax
softmax.description: Converts logits into a distribution that sums to one.
softmax.usage: For CrossEntropy training it is usually omitted and applied at inference.

dropout.label: Dropout
dropout.usage: Regularizes dense layers; p values between 0.1 and 0.5 are common.

dropout2d.label: Dropout 2D
dropout2d.usage: Specific regularization for convolutional feature maps.

batchnorm1d.label: BatchNorm 1D
batchnorm1d.usage: For vectors or 1D signals, usually before activation.

batchnorm2d.label: BatchNorm 2D
batchnorm2d.description: Normalizes each 2D map channel using the batch.
batchnorm2d.usage: Typically placed between Conv 2D and activation.

layernorm.label: LayerNorm
layernorm.description: Normalizes per sample over the last dimension.
layernorm.usage: Suitable for sequences and small batches.

sequence_projection.label: Sequence projection
sequence_projection.description: Projects each time step to a model dimension.
sequence_projection.usage: First layer for numeric sequences before a Transformer.

embedding.label: Token embedding
embedding.description: Maps integer tokens to dense vectors.
embedding.usage: First layer for text or categorical token inputs.

positional_encoding.label: Positional encoding
positional_encoding.description: Adds position information to token or patch embeddings.
positional_encoding.usage: Place it after Embedding in Transformer models.

transformer_encoder.label: Transformer encoder
transformer_encoder.description: Stack of multi-head attention and feed-forward layers.
transformer_encoder.usage: Processes the full sequence with bidirectional attention.

causal_transformer.label: Causal transformer
causal_transformer.description: Masked multi-head attention for autoregressive modeling.
causal_transformer.usage: Use it for next-token prediction and generation.

sequence_pool.label: Sequence pooling
sequence_pool.description: Reduces the time dimension to a single vector.
sequence_pool.usage: Connect before the final Dense head in classifiers.

patch_embedding.label: Patch embedding
patch_embedding.description: Splits an image into patches and embeds each one.
patch_embedding.usage: First layer of a ViT; place Positional encoding after it.

causalpad1d.label: Causal padding 1D
causalpad1d.description: Pads the input so that the output does not depend on future steps.
causalpad1d.usage: Use before causal Conv 1D to keep the receptive field causal.
